commit.message:
[NV] Expand intersection offsets to 64-bit (#1054)

This PR cherry-picks for upstreaming the expansion of intersection
offsets to 64-bit. This is necessary to handle larger numbers of
Gaussians in reconstructions where the number of Gaussian-tile
intersections exceeds the 32-bit limit.
